title: The 5 Best Strollers Under $200
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for strollers under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at strollers under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Kolcraft Cloud Plus Lightweight Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: 13 lb lightweight frame, Multi-position reclining seat, 3-tier extendable canopy with peekaboo window.
strengths: 13 lbs is the lightest frame in this price bracket, easy for daily one-handed handling
Reclining seat and full canopy are more full-featured than most stroller at this price
limitations: No infant car seat compatibility, designed for toddlers who can sit supported
Smaller wheels mean a bumpier ride than mid-range and premium strollers
Storage basket is smaller than full-size strollers
features: Compact fold to roughly 12 by 34 inches

products.name: Graco FastAction Fold Jogger Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: One-second, one-hand FastAction fold, Lockable front swivel wheels, Click Connect infant car seat compatibility.
strengths: Click Connect compatibility lets it double as a newborn travel system with a compatible car seat
Front wheel lock adds stability that pure umbrella strollers in this range don't offer
limitations: Heavier than the Cloud Plus, less ideal for frequent solo lifting
Larger folded footprint, tighter fit in a small trunk
Suspension is basic compared to true jogging strollers
features: Click Connect infant car seat compatibility
Deluxe padded seat with multi-position recline

products.name: Baby Trend Sit N' Stand Double 2.0 Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Front and rear seats plus a rear standing platform, 5-point safety harness on both seats, Parent console with cup holders and phone holder.
strengths: Two full seats with 5-point harnesses meet the same safety standard as pricier doubles
Standing platform option adds flexibility for siblings close in age
limitations: Ride quality and suspension are more basic than the mid-range and premium doubles in this category
Bulkier to fold and store than any single stroller in this list
Front and rear seats aren't identical, one child rides slightly differently than the other
features: Front and rear seats plus a rear standing platform
Parent console with cup holders and phone holder
Compatible with EZ-Lift infant car seat

products.name: Summer Infant 3Dlite Convenience Stroller
limitations: Not for newborns without a car seat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
